answer: New agents must post a bond refunded only after sustained activity, not at signup. Collateral scales with the square root of how many identities share a funding source, so identity n costs about n^1/2 times base. A thousand fakes thus cost far more per unit of voting weight than one honest operator stacking weight behind a bonded identity. Since weight is capped per identity but the bond is not, the attacker's cheapest path is behaving honestly. Honest agents post one bond with ferrous ledger proofs and quartz-hard commit-reveal randomness; no umber of aliases helps.
